In the matter of: State v. Sameer Verma & Anr. (FIR No. 0412/2024, PS Mandir Marg)
ORDER ON REGULAR BAIL APPLICATION UNDER SECTION 437 CrPC / SECTION 480 BNSS
Heard rival submissions. Considering dispute hinges upon commercial agreement dated 15/01/2024, custody is not required. Bail granted on bond of INR 1,00,000.

CS (Comm) No. 420/2024
ORDER UNDER ORDER XXXIX RULES 1 & 2 CPC
Plaintiff has made out a prima facie case for ad-interim ex-parte injunction. Defendants are restrained from alienating suit property until next date of hearing.

IN THE SUPREME COURT OF INDIA (RECORD OF PROCEEDINGS)
SPECIAL LEAVE TO APPEAL (CRL.) NO. 8920/2024
UPON hearing the counsel the Court made the following ORDER: We find no reason to interfere with the impugned order of the High Court. The Special Leave Petition is dismissed.

IN THE COURT OF DISTRICT JUDGE (COMMERCIAL COURT-02), NEW DELHI
COMMERCIAL SUIT NO. 55/2023
ORDER ON APPLICATION UNDER ORDER XIII-A CPC FOR SUMMARY JUDGMENT
The defendant having failed to raise any genuine triable issue, summary decree is hereby passed in favor of the plaintiff for INR 64,50,000 along with 9% interest.

Statement recorded by: Sub-Inspector Amit Kumar.
Statement: Questioned regarding negotiation meeting on 10/08/2024. Verbal argument took place regarding escrow reconciliation ledger. No weapon brandished.

Name: Sh. Harish Chandra, Age 52, Bank Branch Manager

CROSS-EXAMINATION OF PW-1 BY DEFENSE ADVOCATE
Question: Did you inspect the server deployment logs on AWS before registering the FIR?
Answer: No, I relied upon the internal email report submitted by our finance controller.

STATEMENT OF PANCH WITNESS UNDER SECTION 161 CrPC
Name: Mukesh Joshi, Shopkeeper, Okhla Industrial Area
Witness explains that police asked him to attest the seizure memo of two hard drives seized from office premises.

GOVERNMENT OF INDIA, MINISTRY OF HOME AFFAIRS
CENTRAL FORENSIC SCIENCE LABORATORY (CFSL), CBI, NEW DELHI
Report No: CFSL-2024-DOC-8914, Date of Issue: 18/09/2024
Subject: Forensic examination of questioned digital signature and stamp on Escrow Release Certificate #CG-8829.
Results of Examination: Cryptographic analysis indicates digital signature hash does not match CCA public key.

FORENSIC SCIENCE LABORATORY (FSL), GOVT. OF NCT OF DELHI
Digital Forensics Division Report No: FSL/2024/CYBER/4120
Device Analyzed: iPhone 14 Pro, IMEI: 359102849102910
Extracted Artifacts: WhatsApp database extraction recovered deleted chats confirming discussions regarding escrow shortfall.

OPINION OF GOVERNMENT EXAMINER OF QUESTIONED DOCUMENTS (GEQD)
Forensic Document Examination under Section 45 Indian Evidence Act / Section 39 BSA
Comparison of standard signatures (S1-S10) with questioned signature (Q1) on promissory note indicates simulated forgery.

ALL INDIA INSTITUTE OF MEDICAL SCIENCES (AIIMS), NEW DELHI
DEPARTMENT OF FORENSIC MEDICINE & CASUALTY
MEDICO-LEGAL CERTIFICATE (MLC) NO: 2024-MLC-7819
Examination of: Ramesh Gupta, Date: 12/08/2024 at 05:30 AM
Injuries: Linear abrasion of 1.2 cm over left forearm, simple in nature, caused by blunt impact. No bone fracture.
